detail: AC1: a single combined call (`--to-state planned` + `--description`) materializes the `objective` part from the new description text before the freeze runs, so the frozen objective matches the just-written description instead of going stale/empty. Verified by direct code read of memory-api/crates/ticket-api/src/storage/store.rs L704-739 (description write now runs immediately after enforce_description_write_gate, before the transition-path loop that runs apply_plan_freeze).
